results.title: Commemorating 50 Years
results.content: *   Sustainability Sustainability *   Sustainability in Our Investments We have launched our commemorative book – _By Generations, For Generations: Fifty Years Of Temasek As Told By The People Who Shaped It_ – which chronicles Temasek’s growth and evolution from a Singapore holding company to a global investing firm. Part of the group’s mandate was to identify and invest in innovative technologies with the potential to drive the planet closer towards climate resilience, and Temasek towards a net-zero portfolio. Immanu’el also doubles up as a Director of Emerging Technologies, which looks further into the future, at nascent deep-tech ideas that, with the right support – including from companies like Temasek – could evolve into commercially viable technologies with the potential to make a big difference. “I’ve seen how Temasek puts time, money, commitment and people into bringing real value to communities, now and in the future. ### Sustainability *   Sustainability in Our Investments *   .Temasek
